title: Air Fryer Salmon with Roasted Veg

steps.text: Toss the potatoes ({{potatoes}}) in 1 tbsp of the olive oil with the garlic powder ({{garlic-powder}}), smoked paprika ({{smoked-paprika}}), salt ({{salt}}) and pepper ({{pepper}}).
Air fry the potatoes at 200°C for about 17 minutes, until starting to turn golden.
Add the capsicum ({{capsicum}}), red onion ({{onion}}) and tomatoes ({{tomatoes}}) to the basket. Drizzle with the remaining oil ({{oil*0.5}}), toss gently, and cook a further 10 minutes.
Pat the salmon ({{salmon}} fillets) completely dry, which is the key to crisp skin. Rub with a little olive oil, salt and a pinch of smoked paprika.
Push the veg to the sides, place the salmon skin-side down at 180°C, and cook about 9 minutes, until just opaque through the centre.
Rest the salmon 2 minutes. Squeeze lemon ({{lemon}}) over everything and plate with the veg and chats.

notes.title: Frozen salmon
notes.text: Thaw under cold water in its packaging for 15–20 minutes for the best skin, or cook from frozen at 180°C adding 5–7 minutes. Pat dry either way.
